dataset: BTCUSDT USDⓈ-M perpetual 1m klines for the impulse study (IS only) + cross-check and warm-up archives

scope.not_downloaded: any file dated 2024-01 or later; any ETH file; perpetual archives before 2020-01 do not exist on data.binance.vision (HTTP 404 for 2019-08 .. 2019-12)

timestamp_convention: index = UTC open_time (ns); a bar is usable after open_time + interval; raw_close_time_ms = Binance close_time (open_time + interval - 1 ms)
provider: binance_vision (official monthly archives, SHA256 checked against the published .CHECKSUM)
adjudication_rule: v2 (v1 recorded per day as rule_v1_strict_pass; see impulse_study.data_1m.adjudicate_day): a calendar day whose monthly-1m hourly aggregate differs from the repository 1H OHLC is replaced by the official daily 1m archive iff (a) the daily archive's 24 hourly aggregates equal the repository 1H OHLC exactly, (b) its day volume equals the aggTrades day volume (rel. <= 1e-9), (c) it has no zero-volume minute in which aggTrades records trades, and the monthly archive violates (a) or (c). v1 required minute-exact equality with aggTrades, which fails even on control days where the monthly and daily archives are bit-identical
column_src: perp_1m.src: 0 = monthly archive, 1 = official daily archive (adjudicated replacement)
rebuild: python -m impulse_study.data_1m --build   (raw zips under data/raw/, parquet under data/processed_1m/, both git-ignored)
